<shell skill_resources="3d-dna/tad-calling#scripts/call_tads.py">
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Step: Verify hicexplore environment and tool availability
# Run the call_tads.py --help to confirm the hicexplore environment has
# all required dependencies (hicexplorer, cooler, matplotlib, hicFindTADs).

SCRIPT="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/Biomind_v1/skills/3d-dna/tad-calling/scripts/call_tads.py"

if [ ! -f "$SCRIPT" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: call_tads.py not found at $SCRIPT" >&2
  exit 1
fi

conda run -n hicexplore python "$SCRIPT" --help

rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: call_tads.py --help failed with exit code $rc" >&2
  exit $rc
fi

echo "BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON={\"schema_version\":1,\"produces_observations\":[{\"identity\":\"env_verified\",\"value\":{\"tool_available\":true,\"help_return_code\":0,\"script\":\"$SCRIPT\"}}]}"
</shell>
